description_expanded: Overview5.0(2 reviews)INLET BEACH – Coastal View Luxury Home | Private Heated Pool, Spa & Free 4 Bikes | Sleeps 27 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Coastal View, your ultimate multi-family beach retreat! This custom-designed luxury home offers 8 spacious bedrooms, 9 ensuite bathrooms, two powder rooms, two living areas, and multiple exterior decks, making it the perfect space for large gatherings. Indulge in the luxury of a custom heated pool and spa, where you can unwind and enjoy the coastal breezes. Ample parking adds to the convenience, ensuring easy access for all. Coastal View now includes 4 free bikes with your rental, perfect for rides to the beach, dining, or exploring 30A’s scenic trails. Whether you're lounging by the pool or soaking in the views from the decks, Coastal View promises a truly exceptional stay. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax in the private heated pool and spa or enjoy the panoramic views from one of the many outdoor decks. Beach access is steps away via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover (note: includes stairs and is not handicap accessible). HOME FEATURES 8 bedrooms | 10 bathrooms | Sleeps 27 Private heated pool and spa Stunning Gulf views from multiple decks Two large living areas perfect for group comfort Gourmet kitchen with high-end finishes Ample parking for multiple vehicles Smart TVs, and WiFi Elevator for added comfort and convenience Convenient electric vehicle charging on-site Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Close to 30A dining Nearby boutique shopping, and restaurants Quiet Inlet Beach neighborhood for added privacy WHY STAY HERE? Ideal for large families or group getaways Luxurious design with ample space Secluded location near the beach with convenient access to local hotspots Enjoy a getaway where everyone, including your well-behaved fur baby, feels right at home. SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 7 King bedrooms Third floor bunk room with three king beds, 1 queen and 4 twin beds Coastal View is more than just a vacation home. It’s a destination where relaxation, luxury, and memories come together for an unforgettable beach escape on 30A. Please note that nearby construction may occur as the neighborhood continues to grow. Please Note: The neighborhood is growing, and with that comes a bit of construction nearby, including in front of the house. While it’s completely out of our control, we always want to be upfront so there are no surprises. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.Show less
